translations.web: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.
translations.bsb: Like glaze covering an earthen vessel are burning lips and a wicked heart.
translations.kjv: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.
